QQQ.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (unofficial provider client)

interpretation.text:
On 2026-11-09, QQQ’s 252-observation DFA H was 0.491, near the ideal independent, finite-variance returns reference of 0.5. R²=0.972 describes fit quality only across the 12 supplied scales, 8–63 observations. H changed −0.0295 over one observation and +0.0060 over five. Its prior-only, 30-estimate standardized deviation was +0.785; overlapping windows mean this is not a significance test.

Hill alpha was 3.273 over 1,000 observations, using k=100 and x_min=0.01996 absolute log-return units. Conditional on a suitable tail model, lower alpha suggests heavier fitted absolute-return tails; higher suggests thinner tails. The 5%/15% cutoffs gave 3.593/3.040: sensitivity, not a confidence interval.

From 2026-11-06 to 2026-11-09, H fell from 0.520 to 0.491, while alpha edged from 3.300 to 3.273. These are uncertain descriptive estimates, not a crash forecast.
